title: Jatayu tells Rama
topic: Aranya Kanda — dying Jatayu names Ravana
disclaimer: Ashram and wounded Jatayu must match. Grief + testimony. Series recap is this packet's last panels.
story_goal: Empty ashram; dying Jatayu; Rama learns who took Sita; vow.
framework_goal: Grief + testimony + callback to ep 1 location and ep 9 wounds.
gate: Ashram + Jatayu wounded sheet match; series recap one-pager exists (this episode close).
narrative_summary: The hut is empty. The bird still knows the name. Rama vows. The Capture ends; the search is not this series.

fact_checks.claim: Jatayu tells Rama that Ravana took Sita, then dies.

panels.scene_description: Ashram empty. Same layout as ep01-p01. Door black. No Sita.
panels.caption: The kitchen is still there. That is the obscenity, again.

shot_card.camera: wide match ep01-p01 as tightly as boards allow

panels.scene_description: Threshold. The dirt line from ep07, scuffed.

shot_card.camera: close dirt line, his bow in frame
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Rekha remains a choice in the dirt.

panels.scene_description: They find the fall site. Huge wounded wing. Jatayu still alive. Wound matches ep09.
panels.dialogue: LAKSHMANA: That is not a bird. That is a country falling.

shot_card.camera: wide wing landscape, two men arriving

panels.dialogue:
JATAYU: Ravana. Lanka. The sky. I failed the woman.
RAMA: You did not fail the name.

shot_card.camera: close two: eye and Rama's face from ep01

panels.scene_description: He dies. No cute animal afterlife. Wing still ruined.
panels.caption: The job was the name. The job is done.

shot_card.camera: the eye closing, wing still in frame

panels.scene_description: Vow. Few words. Not a trailer speech.
panels.dialogue:
RAMA: Then we walk until the name has a door.
LAKSHMANA: I left her. I know.

panels.scene_description: Recap image: ashram tiny in one direction, sky path implied in the other. No Sita on panel.
panels.caption: Capture series complete. Same slots will take other genres. This was the test.

shot_card.camera: very wide, Rama as a mark between hut and sky

panels.scene_description: Prop: one jewel from the locked set in leaf litter near the fall site — or a blank panel with the metal only.
panels.caption: The trail exists. A2 will ask you to draw it.
